# POL-006 KYC and Client Onboarding Policy

> Fictional document for demonstration. Not a real policy.

## 1. Purpose

Sets the standards for identifying and verifying clients before and during their relationship with Acme.

## 2. Definitions

- **CKYC**: the central KYC registry record.
- **Re-KYC**: periodic re-verification of client information.
- **PEP**: politically exposed person.
- **Risk Category**: Low, Medium or High, assigned at onboarding.

## 3. Onboarding

### 3.1 Mandatory documents

Proof of identity, proof of address, PAN, bank proof, and income proof for derivatives segment activation.

### 3.2 In-person verification

In-person or video verification shall be completed before account activation.

### 3.3 Derivatives activation

Derivatives segments shall be activated only after income proof is verified and the client has acknowledged the risk disclosure document.

## 4. Risk categorisation

| Category | Criteria | Re-KYC cadence |
|---|---|---|
| Low | Salaried, resident, no adverse screening | Every 10 years |
| Medium | Self-employed, HNI, NRI | Every 8 years |
| High | PEP, adverse media, high-risk jurisdiction | Every 2 years |

## 5. Screening

Every client shall be screened against sanctions and PEP lists at onboarding and monthly thereafter.

## 6. Dormant accounts

Accounts with no transaction for 12 months shall be marked dormant and reactivated only after fresh verification.

## 7. Review

Annual review by the CCO.
